rating_note: HIGH is favorable for value, cleanliness, reuse, and optionality; HIGH denotes greater burden for time, effort, dependency, cost, and overfitting risk.

options.definition: Freeze selected hypotheses and wait for genuinely new unseen future data.
options.rationale: Only genuinely new observations can restore unseen evidence, but the wait is long and no validated candidate currently justifies deployment rehearsal.

options.definition: Resolve Family D intraday continuity and Family F authorized catalyst data blockers.
options.rationale: Intraday and catalyst data have broad reuse, but continuity, authorization, licensing, and engineering burdens should be scoped before committing.

options.definition: Develop a distinct economic or behavioral mechanism with independent preregistration.
options.rationale: No distinct mechanism with verified data readiness currently exists; continuing to Family H would force strategy production rather than follow evidence.

options.definition: Pause strategy discovery and strengthen InterSignal as a research, portfolio, and governance platform.
options.rationale: It creates durable research, portfolio-intelligence, risk, lineage, and audit value regardless of alpha success while preserving future options.
